name: gamem-web
description: WebAssembly port of Gamem math, geometry, and physics library

scripts.build:wasm: emcc src/Web/cpp/src/MathGm.cpp src/Web/cpp/src/GeometryGm.cpp src/Web/cpp/src/PhysicsGm.cpp -I src/Web/cpp/include -O3 -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS="['_malloc', '_free']" -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS="['setValue', 'getValue']" -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -o src/Web/src/gamem_wasm.js
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts

author: nicky_sus
